chain_words.nuance: a small or general increase in what one has
money received from work or investments
money left after costs are paid
a substantial financial reward on an investment
a large and unexpected amount of money

explanation: These words all express money gained, from a small general increase to a large and unexpected sum.

usage_notes.difference: 'Earnings' is money received from work or investments, while 'profit' is what remains after costs are subtracted.
